limitations: Disposable headless Linux Chromium at 320×740 and 390×844, Turkish and English, Classic/Feyz. No physical Android, audible-output, screen-lock or service-worker-update acceptance claim.
Common frequency controls, tool tabs, library, cymatics, sweep, breathing and pause use trusted native browser input. Existing public APIs are used for labelled setup and legacy entry-point checks.
Oscillator creation/start/stop/ended events are observed through wrappers which delegate unchanged to native methods. No audio engine, timer, oscillator or user recording is mocked.

One foreground case uses a generated PCM tone in a disposable personal-recording slot; the existing fixture controls only device speech. External traffic and service workers are blocked. No screenshots are produced.
